cloth_sim.source_note: ACWM-Phys Cloth Move 를 PyFleX 로 재생성(원본 아님). 같은 action 재생 시 ACWM 천 마스크 IoU 0.68. 카메라 고정.
cloth_sim.seed_rule: split 기준값 = 10_000_000 + 1_000_000*크기순번(a026=0..a248=8), 테스트는 +500_000, episode seed = 기준값 + episode 번호 (생성 쪽 규칙; 이 실험은 생성하지 않음)

definition.rel_err_self: ||z_hat - z_gt|| / ||z_gt|| per patch (L2 over 384 dims), averaged over cloth patches (real cloth coverage > 0.25) or the rest
definition.nn: min over other episodes of the L2 distance between flattened 196x384 latents at the same step k. ind = episodes of the reference group (ind), same = episodes of the same group (excluding self). ratio = d_nn_ind / d_nn_same (<1: closer to InD-size scenes)

protocol_definitions.strat_cv: (i) same-type latent, 5-fold GroupKFold over episodes stratified by size group
protocol_definitions.gt_transfer: (ii) train on GT encodings only (held-out episodes), apply to predicted latents
protocol_definitions.upper: (iii) train on GT + tf1 + ol latents of all sizes (held-out episodes), test on predicted latents
protocol_definitions.heldout_size: (iv) train on GT encodings of the sizes the world model was trained on (held-out episodes), test on gt/tf1/ol of all sizes, summarised per role

metrics.acc_cls: exact size-class accuracy (classes = ordered sizes of the dataset; null when the class is absent from training)
metrics.r2_within_group: R2 after removing per-group means of y and y_hat
metrics.slope: slope of predicted vs real log-area over all samples
metrics.ci: episode-level cluster bootstrap (resampling within group), 2.5/97.5 percentiles, averaged over probe seeds

probe.label_note: h0..h6 use the area of the input frame; gt/tf1/ol/rvit/pix use the area of the frame the latent represents

definition.tf_response_gain: sum over frames of (pooled projection shift of predictor output) / (pooled projection shift of input), per episode
definition.random: same applied shift magnitude along unit random directions; output read along the same direction
